name: ship-lean
description: Lean overlay for gstack's /ship skill — a UserPromptSubmit hook injects a short note when you type /ship that moves ship Step 9 (specialist dispatch) and Step 11 (adversarial pass) into a read-only parallel Workflow over an out-of-repo patch file, and hardens the push gate to fail toward not pushing. gstack's SKILL.md stays authoritative; all its gates, logging, and bookkeeping run unchanged.
